question: Will the Buffalo Bills finish the 2026 NFL regular season with the league's best win-loss record (sole or tied)?
description: Buffalo were 9-1 after Week 12 of the 2026 season.

resolutionRules.yesCriteria: Resolve YES if no team finishes with a better winning percentage than Buffalo (ties count as YES).
resolutionRules.noCriteria: Resolve NO if any team finishes with a better winning percentage.
